approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A cosy hand-painted illustrated animation, vertical 9:16 composition. A single warm ceramic coffee cup rests on a wooden windowsill beside a rain-streaked window. Frame the cup in the lower-middle of the portrait image with generous space above for delicate curling steam. Warm amber indoor light contrasts with cool muted blue-grey rainy outdoors, softly blurred greenery beyond the glass. Gentle wisps of steam continuously curl upward from the hot coffee while raindrops slowly slide down the window. Soft painterly textures, charming detailed illustration, calm intimate rainy-day atmosphere. Locked-off camera, one uninterrupted shot, stable cup and background, subtle natural movement only. Exactly six seconds. No text, lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, people, music, speech, or sound. Silent video.
